problems.source_says: The paper places the post-test after six intervention weeks. Table 4 lists ChatGPT feedback/support for weeks 2-7 and story writing plus scale assessment for week 8, which suggests an unassisted test but does not explicitly establish that AI assistance or AI examples were unavailable while the scored stories were produced. The statement that pupils did not individually use ChatGPT concerns teacher-mediated assistance throughout the intervention, so it does not establish test-time removal either. The form acknowledges this evidentiary gap, but its categorical no/after_ai values still exceed the explicit support required by this check. Under codebook section 1, after_ai requires output produced after AI removal; both availability and the resulting question classification remain unconfirmed.

summary: Criterion 3 holds: the researcher scored pupils' stories, and the recorded construct, measure, unit and numbers are supported. The no-AI/after_ai coding remains unconfirmed because the paper never explicitly establishes that AI assistance was removed during post-test writing.
